data.one_liner: Removes the hash '#' from web URLs while safely supporting non-web platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a function to configure the URL strategy for Flutter web applications to use clean paths instead of hash-based URLs. It safely acts as a no-op on non-web platforms to maintain cross-platform compatibility.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application and want clean URLs without the '#' character
You need a cross-platform codebase where URL strategy configuration does not break mobile or desktop builds
avoid_when: Your web server cannot be configured to handle client-side routing and clean paths
You are not targeting the web platform
strengths: Simplifies URL strategy configuration for Flutter web
Zero configuration needed for non-web platforms
weaknesses: Requires proper server-side configuration to support deep linking with clean paths on the web
Limited feature set restricted solely to URL strategy configuration
data.setup_notes: Call setPathUrlStrategy() in your main function before runApp().
